verdict.rationale: llamafile documents support for GGUF models across several LLM families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) and multimodal image models (Qwen3.5, Ministral3, llava1.6). Speech-to-text ships separately via whisperfile. The evidence does not show breadth on the scale of hundreds of architectures, and it says nothing about MoE or embedding models. missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of supported architectures, MoE model support, embedding model support, independent corroboration of architecture breadth

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: Supports GGUF models including Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi.
